reasons: (a) The gold's contract ('Append the unescaped form of a backslash escaped text') is violated by its own code on the trigger input: for 'one \( \) \\' it drops the escaped backslash as well as the escape characters and returns 'one ( ) '. Hops 1-4 only guard, size a builder or pass through; each meets its own documentation and is wrong only through its callee. (b) Every hop javadoc matches its code: hop 1's 'a text that holds no backslash is returned as is' is exactly its guard, hop 2's 'accumulated in a builder sized to the value' is exactly its body, hops 3 and 4 delegate. None of them claims any per-character decision, so no hop can reasonably be blamed. (c) All three passing non-gold edits are bypasses, not competing repairs. A1, a one-line placeholder at hop 1, turns any U+0000 in the input into a backslash ('a\u0000\\b' -> 'a\\b'), which goes against hop 1's own contract. It also drops the third backslash of a run of three ('\\\x' -> '\x', where the gold gives '\\x'). That breaks the raw previous-character rule that chompBalanced pins (last != ESC: any character directly after a backslash is literal). A2, at hop 2, is five lines. It moves the pair decision out of the gold and has the same run-of-three deviation. A3 replaces the chain's result with a regex and makes hops 2-5 dead. The declared G9 compensations at hops 1, 2 and 4 do not absorb the fault (validation and my reading agree). Java source level 1.6 rules out a one-line split/join at a hop. (d) The names (unescapedText, unescapedValue, appendUnescapedText, appendUnescapedChars, appendUnescaped) are neutral and in the host's vocabulary. The gold's javadoc is the same as hops 3 and 4 and does not state the escaped-backslash rule. The gold has no comment. The faulty gold reads as an ordinary complete scan. The lie (characters read from the end and pushed onto a stack) does not name the fault or the omitted step. (e) The gold is exactly five calls below the facade. The facade body is one delegating call; the original had no guard. One procedural lie sentence was added. The trigger TokenQueueTest::unescape is an existing test, and the full suite shows it as the only failure on the variant (0 failures with the gold line restored). Hosts were judged against BUILD_BRIEF_C10F_ADDENDUM section 1. The checkout has no public class of at least 1500 lines other than TokenQueue (TokeniserState 1734 and HtmlTreeBuilderState 1513 are package-private enums; Connection 719 is an interface), so largest5 mode applies. The five largest public non-interface, non-enum classes by newline count are Element 1290, HttpConnection 1114, Evaluator 750, HtmlTreeBuilder 706 and Node 703. They hold hops 1-5 in that order, with the gold in the fifth and smallest host as required. (f) The convention is pinned outside the gold. chompBalanced's last != ESC rule is the same raw previous-character test the gold's omitted line performs, and its javadoc directs callers to unescape its output. QueryParser.contains and containsData unescape that output, while matches keeps the escapes. The passing ownership tests chompEscapedBalanced, chompBalanced, testPsuedoContainsWithParentheses and containsWithQuote pin that the escape is dropped and the escaped character kept.
